description: Two views of the same small chibi pixel art character, bald, with long pointed ears: on the left seen from the front, on the right seen from behind. Paint only inside the white of the mask: give the bald head long high twin tails: the hair tied into two thick tails high on either side of the head, each tail falling in soft wavy locks past the shoulders down to the waist, beside the body in both views, with soft bangs swept a little to one side. A full fringe of bangs comes down to just above the eyes, so no bare forehead shows, and the hair covers the whole top of the head. The hair falls in clear thick locks with darker lines between them, and every end tapers into points of slightly different lengths, never one straight cut. The same hairstyle in both views, in big bold locks. The hair is one bright grass green, shaded only with darker greens and outlined with the same thick dark outline, with no other colours inside the hair. The long pointed ears still poke out through the hair. Do not change the face, the eyes, the body or the clothes. Keep the same chunky pixel size and the same flat shading, nothing else added, transparent background.
